name: Sicilian Sveshnikov — Black Tactics
description: 4 strategic challenges for Black in the Sveshnikov main line. Fight for activity and queenside space after White's developing move!

drills.name: The b4 Break
drills.description: Black to play. The queenside pawn lever b4 undermines White’s c3-knight and seizes the initiative.
drills.briefExplanation: b4! kicks the c3-knight; after Bxf6 gxf6 Black’s queenside majority starts rolling.
drills.explanation: Black to move. There is a real tactic here: b4 winning material. Line: 1. b4 Bxf6 2. gxf6 Nab5 3. bxc3. Stockfish 18 (depth 16) evaluates the result at +2.74 for Black, 2.39 pawns better than the next-best alternative.
